verdict.rationale: Independent review evidence (Tom's Hardware) finds the RTX 5090 the fastest GPU tested "most of the time," which corroborates NVIDIA's gaming-performance positioning around DLSS Multi Frame Generation and path tracing. However, no evidence gives 4K-specific frame rates. Reviewers also caution that MFG's headline FPS does not equal native high-refresh responsiveness, since input is sampled at the base rate, and they note driver issues in some games. Missing for 10: explicit 4K game benchmark figures, independent confirmation of native high-refresh 4K frame rates, and validation of vendor MFG FPS claims without latency caveats.

support.subject: As a gamer, this card drives high-refresh 4K gaming — vendor performance claims corroborated by independent game benchmarks
